fields: L4 Beijing / Chinese New Year (tricycle; Shichahai hutong → Chang'an Avenue → Summer Palace). Same item fields as L3 v3.1. Pools keep L3 names so pickSetL2 + l3TypeUniq can be reused: seawall = Lantern Riddle Stand 灯谜摊 questions (3–4 choices, timed 30 s; also the retry pool), forest_fork = Chang'an Avenue fork signs (≤3 choices; sign_en/sign_zh; EN ≤24 chars, ZH width ≤12), peak_final = Seventeen-Arch Bridge final 十七孔桥终极题 (exactly 4 choices, hard, situational). Per run: 5 riddle-stand + 4 fork + 1 final = 10. Every item has qtype + qtype_zh (each qtype at most once per run). {name} = player name; English on top, Chinese below. No subject capybara/beaver. Lantern riddles are object/animal riddles solvable in both languages (subject 'riddle'). Stems are deduped against all L1–L3 banks (all grades).

questions.explain_zh: 马第七，羊第八，猴第九。

questions.subject: beijing
questions.q_en: From the Seventeen-Arch Bridge, Flora looks across Kunming Lake to the Tower of Buddhist Incense on the hill. How is the tower built?
questions.q_zh: Flora 站在十七孔桥上，隔着昆明湖望见山上的佛香阁。佛香阁是怎样的建筑？
choices: Eight sides, three storeys, four layers of eaves
questions.explain_en: The tower is octagonal with 3 storeys and 4 layers of eaves on a high base.
questions.explain_zh: 佛香阁八面三层四重檐，建在高台上。

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: 20 visitors are on the Seventeen-Arch Bridge at sunset, and 40% of them carry lanterns. How many carry lanterns?
questions.q_zh: 傍晚十七孔桥上有 20 位游客，其中 40% 提着灯笼，有多少人提着灯笼？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: The 49 lanterns on the bridge are red and gold in the ratio 2:5. How many are red?
questions.q_zh: 桥上 49 个灯笼，红灯笼和金灯笼的比是 2:5，红灯笼有多少个？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: Over four evenings, Flora counts 26, 31, 37 and 30 lantern boats floating near the bridge. What is the mean number per evening?
questions.q_zh: 连续四个晚上，Flora 在桥边数到 26、31、37、30 只灯船，平均每晚几只？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A triangular banner on the bridge reads "Happy New Year". Its base is 22 dm and its height is 12 dm. What is its area in dm²?
questions.q_zh: 桥上一面写着“过年好”的三角形彩旗，底 22 分米、高 12 分米，面积是多少平方分米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A round lantern hanging under the bridge has a diameter of 35 cm. Using π ≈ 3.14, how many cm of gold trim go once around it?
questions.q_zh: 桥下挂着一个直径 35 厘米的圆灯笼，π 取 3.14，绕它一圈的金边要多少厘米？

questions.subject: math
questions.q_en: A gift box of New Year sweets on the bridge is 32 cm × 29 cm × 18 cm. What is its volume in cm³?
questions.q_zh: 桥上一个年货礼盒长 32 厘米、宽 29 厘米、高 18 厘米，体积是多少立方厘米？
